title: KeyMaterial/fetch uses up KeyPackages with no Commit following (clean-room C21)
description: C21: KeyMaterial/fetch consumes KeyPackages even when no commit follows. Decide with Mark if behaviour or draft text changes; do after air-impl merges.
close_reason: By design, no change (code reading, mimid-agent-core at 1ecf16b3). The agent calls KeyMaterial/fetch only in Agent::invite, right before build_commit, which writes the UpdateRequest (the fetched KeyPackages inside the Commit's Adds and Welcome) to the outbox in one transaction. A retry after a lost answer or crash (finish_outbox -> send_update) resends entry.wire byte for byte and never calls invite, so it never fetches again (covered by mimid-agent-store tests/send_crash.rs, the invite of carol at BeforeSend/AfterAccepted). A refused Commit (wrongEpoch, notAllowed) is not retried automatically; a new invite is a new Commit and fetches anew. This meets the draft's SHOULD (fetch only when ready to commit; reuse a fetched KeyPackage when retrying the same Commit).
